input.command:
su - postgres -c "psql -p 5433 -c 'ALTER USER benchmark_user WITH SUPERUSER;'"
cd /testbed/migrations
for f in $(ls *.sql | sort); do
  echo "Applying $f"
  PGPASSWORD=benchmark_pass psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5433 -U benchmark_user -d benchmark_db -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f" || exit 1
done
